description: Databricks JOB compute — a new single-node cluster per run, terminated when the run ends. Job DBUs cost roughly half the all-purpose rate, and nothing is left idling. The wheel is attached from a Unity Catalog volume rather than DBFS, which is deprecated and restricted under UC.

typeProperties._comment_workers: 0 workers. The singleNode profile above and a worker count are contradictory, and the driver alone is 4 vCPUs against a 4-vCPU regional quota — asking for a worker means the cluster never starts, and Databricks reports that as a timeout several minutes in.
